# BaeMeds (baemeds.in)

> Certified Medical Equipment Sales, Rentals, and Home Healthcare Services in Hyderabad and Pan-India.

## About BaeMeds
BaeMeds (operated by Mohsin Enterprises) is a trusted medical equipment and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) supplier based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We provide certified hospital-grade equipment sales, rental services, doorstep delivery, installation, and 24/7 patient technical support.

## Core Medical Equipment Categories & Offerings
- [Oxygen Concentrator Sales & Rental](https://www.baemeds.in/oxygen-concentrator-rental-hyderabad): 5LPM & 10LPM medical oxygen concentrators from top brands (Oxymed, BPL, Olive, Philips Respironics) with same-day delivery in Hyderabad.
- [BiPAP & CPAP Machine Sales & Rental](https://www.baemeds.in/bipap-machine-on-rent-hyderabad): Sleep apnea and respiratory therapy equipment including ResMed AirSense 10 AutoSet, ResMed Lumis 100 VPAP ST, ResMed Lumis 150 AVAPS, and Philips DreamStation.
- [Multipara Patient Monitors](https://www.baemeds.in/patient-monitor-price-hyderabad): Certified vital signs monitoring equipment for clinics, hospitals, and home ICU setups.
- [Hospital Furniture](https://www.baemeds.in/products?category=Hospital%20Furniture): Manual and motorized ICU hospital beds, fowler beds, and air mattresses for bed sores.
- [Medical Masks & Tubing](https://www.baemeds.in/products?category=Masks%20%26%20Accessories): ResMed AirFit N20, F20, and CPAP/BiPAP accessories.
- [All Products Catalog](https://www.baemeds.in/products): Full medical catalogue including suction machines, nebulizers, wheelchairs, ECG machines, and glucometers.
- [Hospital Bulk Orders](https://www.baemeds.in/bulk-orders): B2B wholesale hospital supplies and institutional quotations with GST invoicing.
